name: Wirehook Self-Hosted Webhook Tester
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted stateless webhook tester with real-time request inspection; no vendor request quota or paid software license; Docker deployment supported.
watch_out: You supply hosting, public endpoint, networking and TLS; Wirehook is stateless and does not retain incoming webhook payloads, so it is not a durable event queue or managed relay.
